== About Me ==
{|cellspacing="5" cellpadding="5" width="100%"|
| width="70%" valign="top" |
Welcome to my User Page. My name is '''FFXI-Mierin''', and I am an founder and Administrator of the '''[http://wiki.ffxiclopedia.org FFXIclopedia]''' wiki, a gaming wiki for the '''Final Fantasy XI''' MMORPG. My name used to be just Mierin, but someone over here had it before we joined Wikia, and thus my name got changed. My main character name in the game is [[Mierin]]. As you've probably already guessed by now, my name is derived from Lanfear's original name before becoming a Forsaken, as are all my character names in FFXI: [[Bain]], [[Elmindreda]], [[Graendal]], [[Arent]], and [[Gaul]]. Please also feel free to visit my [http://wiki.ffxiclopedia.org/wiki/User:FFXI-Mierin userpage] over on FFXIclopedia.

I have read books one through three numerous times, four through eight a couple of times, and nine and ten once each. I have not read ''Knife of Dreams'', yet, but plan to shortly.
